headline: Trilegal acts on Berry Street - Healthify merger
sum: Trilegal has advised Berry Street Health, Inc., a U.S.-based digital nutrition care company, on Indian law aspects of Healthify’s merger with the Berry Street group. The Trilegal Corporate Team advising on the matter was led by Wiseroy…
detail: Trilegal has advised Berry Street Health, Inc., a U.S.-based digital nutrition care company, on Indian law aspects of Healthify’s merger with the Berry Street group. The Trilegal Corporate Team advising on the matter was led by Wiseroy Damodaran (Partner), and comprised Parmeshwar Prapann (Senior Associate), Nishka Tyagi (Senior Associate), and Juhi Wadhwani (Associate). Aditi Goyal (Partner), Kartikey Kulshrestha (Counsel), Aishwarya Palan (Senior Associate), and Paras Arora (Associate) advised on tax law aspects. Swarnima (Partner), Aaryana Anand (Senior Associate), Sohail Hafesjee (Senior Associate), and Anuj Nikhil Joglekar (Associate) advised on employment law aspects.
